description: This dataset gives 54 hydrologic years, October 1964 to September 2018, of monthly and yearly operation data for Dez Dam in the Dez basin of Iran, supplied by the Khuzestan Water and Power Authority and described in a Data in Brief article. Series cover turbine outflow, reservoir inflow and volume, evaporation, precipitation, spillway and total outflow, water level, power generation and demand, with the dam's operating limits. The article also reports scenario results for changing full supply level, minimum operating level and constant operating level, and proposes a water-energy productivity index. Coverage is one reservoir. The data are free in the supplementary file of the open access article under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: data come from one authority for one dam, and the scenario results depend on the authors' operation analysis. Simulation uses: calibrating and testing reservoir operation and hydropower-water supply trade-off models. Related records: the Upper Krishna reservoir operation benchmark (data-upper-krishna-reservoir-operation-model-benchmark) and CONUS reservoir inflow, storage and release (data-cmip6-mosartwmpy-conus-reservoir-inflow-storage-release).
